entries.title: Show HN: I made a tiny device for automatically recording digital pianos

entries.current_title: Show HN: I made a tiny device for automatically recording digital pianos
entries.excerpt: Hey HN! A few years ago, I left my cushy big tech job to make hardware. And made the device I always wanted - an automatic piano recorder! I usually play piano improvisationally, and manually hitting record never meshed well with that. But there are always moments I wish I recorded, and now they are! entries.guide_zh: 为随时保留即兴弹奏，作者制作自动记录数码钢琴演奏的小设备。

entries.author: arrdalan
entries.current_title: Show HN: Open-source private home security camera system (end-to-end encryption)
entries.excerpt: I needed a security camera inside my house, one that would send motion notifications to my smartphone and would allow me to livestream remotely. entries.title: Show HN: HTML-to-Markdown – convert entire websites to Markdown with Golang/CLI
entries.author: JohannesKauf
entries.current_title: Show HN: HTML-to-Markdown – convert entire websites to Markdown with Golang/CLI
entries.excerpt: Hey HN! I originally built “html-to-markdown” back in 2018 (while still in high school) to handle complex HTML conversions where other libraries struggled. Now, I’ve released v2 — a complete rewrite designed to handle even more edge cases. It supports entire websites with a high accuracy. Example use: I’ve used it in my RSS reader to strip HTML down to clean Markdown, similar to the "Reader Mode" in your Browser. It can be used as a Golang package or as an CLI. Give it a try
entries.guide_zh: HTML-to-Markdown 重写第二版，用 Go 和命令行处理复杂网页转换。
